title: PORTER-CABLE Angle Grinder Tool, 4-1/2-Inch, 7.5-Amp (PC750AG)
description:
About this item
Durable 7.5-amp motor of the angle grinder powers through jobsite tasks with ease
Cast metal gear housing increases jobsite durability and tool longevity of the metal grinder
3-position adjustable side handle of hand grinder allows greater control in multiple positions
Soft grip handle improves user comfort and control
Spindle lock feature allows for single wrench bit changes

reviews_5s:
Great item BUT now with Tariffs, the cost is way over the top.Funciona bienGreat price. Love the design over junk Dewalt that it replaced. Hope it lasts. PC is reported to be of lesser quality since Stanley BD bought them. Love the mini rat tail design.I haven't used it much yet but it seems well built.Well made variable speed 4 1/2” angle grinder
Porter Cable is reputable brand name in power tool industry
Only downside no longer made in Tennessee..Does a nice job. Seems to be well made & works really well. Has plenty of power & controls are set up well. I’ve made a couple of hundred cuts with it on 1/8” & 1/4”thick Aluminum & it handles it with no problem. Would give it a good recommendation!This is my first angle grinder, so I've really nothing to compare it to. However, I love that the on/off switch is activated by pressure, so if you let go, it shuts off. I'm not sure why one reviewer said it was dangerous. I can't imagine a switch any safer. It does take the tool a few seconds to slow down and stop, so once you let go, it does have a about 7-8 seconds before it comes to a complete stop, which could be a problem if snags a piece of clothing or body part. But no tool could stop immediately, so.

I've used this on hard wood such as walnut and oak and it does a great job with sanding discs and curved flip discs. It is heavy, but again, I imagine that lends a level of safety. I often have to stop and take a rest when I'm doing some heavy wood removal, but it's a power horse for what I need.

I have had some issue with it burning wood occassionally, but that may be the super hard wood or...operator error. As I said I'm new to the angle grinder. If anyone has any input or it burning wood, please reply.Product just as described. Brand new, durable. Great price, fast shipping.I bought a Metabo grinder of the same size because I had been told they were great tools. It lasted 6 months. Bought one of these Porter Cable Grinders at Lowes out of immediate need and that was all I had for a choice. It lasted 3 years! I have since bought these exclusively and they all last an incredibly long time in a less than ideal environment. We have a fab shop and they get used every day, and not always treated nicely. Hope they keep making them!Appears to be a good product and it should work well.
reviews_1s:
I used it once and it worked very well. Then the disc could not be removed. I have used other angle grinders and not had this problem.
I contacted Porter Cable customer service who responded with the most generic email response that did not pertain to the question.UPDATE, BOUGHT THREE OF THESE, NOW IT'S $30 DOLLARS MORE! HECK OF A PRICE INCREASE.

I have bought two of these, not a bad little grinders for the price point. it has one issue that can be fixed with two small rubber O-rings, seems the backing plate is sloppy around the shaft, this let's the wheel to be mounted out of round, it's not much but noticeable. two metric rings fit best (can't remember the exact size ATM) but it's not hard to figure out. and improves mounting.
I don't know how long these will last, the shaft bearing holder is not metal it's plastic, so if you drop it on the guard I don't know if it will crack, so we shall see, I guess to lower the price they had to cheap out someplace, kind of like most everthing in life these days. If it was a hundred dollars I would be returning them.
Some complain about the switch but I see no problem, just have to be flexible and know how to get used to different tools. instructions state "No cut off wheels" , it's because it's not a ohchit regulated guard now required these day's just be wearing eye and face pro when using.This machine has great torque, but the downside is that the gear head heats up way to quickly. Porter cable in my life time has always been the goto tool. Very disappointedI ordered this to replace a broken Bosch grinder. I have muscular dystrophy so weight really matters. According to the specs, this is supposed to weigh 3.5 lbs which is less than the Bosch grinder. When it arrived, it seemed quite heavy. 6lbs, 12oz is nearly double the listed weight. I am returning it and buying another Bosch.Once upon a time Porter cable was my go-to tool company. Not so much anymore. My las two didn't last more that few months and this time the grinder I bought didn't work out of the box. Since I waited too long before trying to use it I missed the return date. I contacted Porter Cable to have it repaired under warranty. The Grinder was shipped to their Georgia repair center and was received months ago. I still have no resolution and repeated attempts to get an answer from Porter Cable has been fruitless. Beware if you will need anything done under warranty. You may be without your tool for a very long time.Overheated and started on fire first use. Using a diamond blade to strip paint off wood Even with frequent stops it over heated and shot flames out the front Unfortunately that did not mean supercharged. Just super dead

UPDATE: Called customer service, apparently offshore because both representatives had very heavy accents. They offered to repair. Had to explain that it was burning inside, can't repair that. Finally offered to replace. Said it would be here in two weeks. Well that was over three weeks ago.I used this for less than a week when the motor burned out. I bought it 45 days before and so I couldn't return it. I thought Porter Cable was supposed to be a quality brand, but I guess I was wrong.The Product Information/Technical Details section of the product description stated this grinder had the variable speed feature. I paid a higher price for that feature, because I needed that (I have 3 other grinders like this). This grinder does NOT have a variable speed feature. I'm sure it would be OK for someone who does not need variable speed.grinder died after about 20 minutes of on and off use over a 2-month period. Motor started to smoke and quit working. to late to return to amazon.. D. NOT buy this piece of junkI used it with a wire brush for less than 15 minutes and grease started oozing out of the case. The gear housing may be made out of metal, but the gears themselves must be made out of plastic or paper mache. I suspect it was bad from the start because it vibrated so badly, that after 2 minutes of use, I had to set it down because I couldn't hold on to it any longer. My 15 year old Skill is still far better. The only good thing about it is it prompted me to get a cordless Milwaukee. WAY nicer.
